one_liner_zh: 福特汽車最新季度財報顯示EPS優於預期，但營收年減。
one_liner_en: Ford Motor Company reported a positive EPS surprise despite a year-over-year revenue decline.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 實際值 0.42 美元優於預估的 0.35 美元。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘（EPS）為 0.42 美元，顯著優於市場預期的 0.35 美元。
超越預期的獲利展現了公司在成本控管與營運效率上的改善。
整體獲利表現優於分析師原先共識。
highlights_en: Earnings per share (EPS) came in at $0.42, beating the estimated $0.35.
Cost control and operational efficiency contributed to the earnings beat.
Overall profitability outperformed analyst consensus expectations.
risks_zh: 營收較去年同期下滑 3.76%，顯示頂線成長面臨壓力。
汽車產業需求波動與總體經濟不確定性可能影響後續表現。
risks_en: Revenue declined by 3.76% year-over-year, indicating top-line growth pressure.
Automotive demand volatility and macroeconomic uncertainty could impact future performance.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：獲利優於預期提供短期支撐，但營收下滑凸顯成長動能受限。對股價短中期意涵為中性偏多，需密切追蹤後續營收成長動能與車市需求變化。
ai_view_en: view: Earnings beat provides short-term support, but revenue decline highlights growth constraints. The near-to-mid-term stock implication is neutral to positive; track top-line growth momentum and vehicle demand trends closely.
